title: GPU memory exhaustion
description: GPU memory utilization exceeded 95%, indicating likely CUDA OOM risk.

title: Production deadline at risk
summary: Production is forecast to miss its deadline
description: The delivery forecast is now late. Investigate the active render condition and approve a recovery plan.

title: Render worker capacity loss
summary: Available GPU worker capacity has dropped
description: Fewer than 150 GPU workers are active, putting throughput and delivery at risk.

title: Storage capacity exhausted
description: Storage utilization exceeded 95%. New render outputs may fail or stall.

title: Asset corruption detected
description: More than 5% of assets are failing, causing deterministic scene retries.

title: Critical dependency unavailable
summary: A required production dependency is unavailable
description: The simulator reports a dependency outage that can stop dispatch and rendering.
